title: Velocity of ball B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity of ball B as 1.75 m/s using the average velocity over interval AC.

title: Number of balls above A
description: Essential: Correctly determines there are 2 balls rolling above ball A at the time of the photo.

title: Acceleration calculation
description: Important: Applies the correct formula for uniform acceleration (e.g., Δs = a t²) to find a = 5 m/s² from AB and BC.

title: Time of flight for B
description: Important: Correctly uses v = a t to find the falling time of ball B (0.35 s) from its velocity and the acceleration.

title: Time of flight for A
description: Important: Correctly subtracts the 0.1 s interval from ball B's time to find ball A's falling time (0.25 s).

title: Unit conversion
description: Optional: Converts distances from cm to m consistently before performing calculations.

title: Misapplied average velocity
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula for the average or instantaneous velocity of ball B (e.g., using only AB or BC).

title: Sign or interval error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error with the time interval (0.1 s) when finding the time for ball A or the number of balls.
